concerns.text: User Story US1 (Data Ingestion) lacks any anchored Functional Requirement (FR) or Success Criterion (SC). While SC-001 mentions 'ingests and processes >1,000 entries', it does not explicitly reference US1, nor does any FR describe the CIF-to-graph conversion logic required by the story. This leaves the implementation of the ingestion pipeline unbacked by concrete requirements.

User Story US3 (Feature Importance) is not explicitly anchored by any FR or SC. SC-005 mentions 'Feature importance analysis identifies at least 3 structural descriptors', which aligns with the story's goal, but lacks an explicit traceability link (e.g., 'See US3' or 'Anchored to US3'). Without this link, the requirement stands as a potential orphan or implicit assumption rather than a verified coverage of the user story.

Success Criterion SC-004 ('Peak memory usage... remains within acceptable system limits') is vague and unanchored. It does not reference a specific User Story (e.g., US2 for training) nor does it define the 'acceptable system limits' numerically (referencing the 7GB constraint in Section 4 is good, but the SC itself should explicitly state the metric and threshold to be testable and anchored).
